title: The structural landscape and diversity of Pyricularia oryzae MAX effectors revisited
authors: Lahfa M; Barthe P; De Guillen K; Cesari S; Raji M; Kroj T; Le Naour--Vernet M; Hoh F; Gladieux P; Roumestand C; Gracy J; Declerck N; Padilla A
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合NMR实验与AlphaFold2建模，系统分析稻瘟菌MAX效应子的结构景观与多样性，虽涉及蛋白结构预测和表面理化性质，但对象为折叠蛋白效应子而非无序蛋白/IDR，且未聚焦PPI结合机制或相分离，方法上AI建模有启发但互作机制深度有限。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Magnaporthe AVRs and ToxB-like (MAX) effectors constitute a family of secreted virulence proteins in the fungus Pyricularia oryzae (syn. Magnaporthe oryzae) , which causes blast disease on numerous cereals and grasses. In spite of high sequence divergence, MAX effectors share a common fold characterized by a ß-sandwich core stabilized by a conserved disulfide bond. In this study, we investigated the structural landscape and diversity within the MAX effector repertoire of P. oryzae. Combining experimental protein structure determination and in silico structure modeling we validated the presence of the conserved MAX effector core domain in 77 out of 94 groups of orthologs (OG) identified in a previous population genomic study. Four novel MAX effector structures determined by NMR were in remarkably good agreement with AlphaFold2 (AF2) predictions. Based on the comparison of the AF2-generated 3D models we propose a classification of the MAX effectors superfamily in 20 structural groups that vary in the canonical MAX fold, disulfide bond patterns, and additional secondary structures in N- and C-terminal extensions. About one-third of the MAX family members remain singletons, without strong structural relationship to other MAX effectors. Analysis of the surface properties of the AF2 MAX models also highlights the high variability within the MAX family at the structural level, potentially reflecting the wide diversity of their virulence functions and host targets.

Author summary

MAX effectors are a family of virulence proteins from the plant pathogenic fungus Pyricularia (syn. Magnaporthe) oryzae that share a similar 3D structure despite very low amino-acid sequence identity. Characterizing the function and evolution of these proteins requires a detailed understanding of their structural diversity. With this in mind, we have determined the NMR structures of four new MAX effectors and shown a near-perfect match with the corresponding AlphaFold2 (AF2) models. We then applied a prediction pipeline based on similarity searches with structural modeling using the AF2 software to predict MAX effectors in a collection of 120 P. oryzae genomes. The resulting models and experimental structures revealed that the MAX core while preserved is highly permissive to secondary structure variations and may coexists with extensive structural diversity in terms of structured N- or C-terminal extensions permitting their classification. For a subset of AF2 models, we have also analyzed the physico-chemical properties of the core domain surfaces, adding another, more functional perspective, notably surface electrostatics and stickiness. This work constitutes a major step in understanding the relationships among MAX effectors by analyzing their structural landscape and cataloguing specific physico-chemical properties. It also provides valuable insights for guiding research into the putative targets of these effectors in infected plant hosts.
abstract_zh:
摘要

Magnaporthe AVRs和ToxB-like（MAX）效应子是稻瘟病菌（Pyricularia oryzae，异名Magnaporthe oryzae）中的一类分泌型毒力蛋白家族，该真菌导致多种谷物和禾本科植物的稻瘟病。尽管序列差异显著，MAX效应子共享一个共同折叠，其特征是由保守二硫键稳定的ß-三明治核心。在本研究中，我们探讨了P. oryzae中MAX效应子库的结构景观和多样性。结合实验性蛋白质结构测定和计算机结构建模，我们验证了先前群体基因组学研究中鉴定的94个直系同源组（OG）中77个存在保守的MAX效应子核心结构域。通过NMR确定的四个新型MAX效应子结构与AlphaFold2（AF2）预测结果高度一致。基于AF2生成的3D模型比较，我们提出将MAX效应子超家族分为20个结构组，这些组在典型MAX折叠、二硫键模式以及N端和C端延伸中的额外二级结构方面存在差异。约三分之一的MAX家族成员仍为单例，与其他MAX效应子无强结构关联。对AF2 MAX模型表面性质的分析也突显了MAX家族在结构水平上的高度变异性，这可能反映了其毒力功能和宿主靶标的广泛多样性。

作者总结

MAX效应子是植物病原真菌Pyricularia（异名Magnaporthe）oryzae中的一类毒力蛋白家族，尽管氨基酸序列同一性极低，它们共享相似的三维结构。表征这些蛋白质的功能和进化需要详细了解其结构多样性。为此，我们确定了四个新MAX效应子的NMR结构，并显示其与相应AlphaFold2（AF2）模型几乎完美匹配。随后，我们应用基于相似性搜索和AF2软件结构建模的预测流程，在120个P. oryzae基因组集合中预测MAX效应子。所得模型和实验结构揭示，MAX核心虽被保留，但对二级结构变异高度容忍，并可能伴随结构化N端或C端延伸的广泛结构多样性，从而允许对其进行分类。对于一部分AF2模型，我们还分析了核心结构域表面的物理化学性质，增加了另一个更功能性的视角，特别是表面静电学和粘性。这项工作通过分析MAX效应子的结构景观并编目特定物理化学性质，构成了理解它们之间关系的重要一步，也为指导研究这些效应子在受感染植物宿主中假定靶标提供了宝贵见解。
